facts.fact: The minister for digital transition says the ANSSI national information systems security agency exists and its CSIRT and SOC are in service.
The minister says Burkina Faso recorded over 200 alerts a month in 2023, with declared attacks handled, ransomware 35% and phishing 40%.

systems.country_label: Agence nationale de sécurité des systèmes d'information

facts.fact: The minister cites a law on information systems security adopted on 9 July 2024.
facts.system: Loi portant sécurité des systèmes d'information

BFA.note: Data protection is named only as an institutional mission; no law stated.
